sources.snippet: This model was initialized from Qwen3-14B by copying every other layer and the last 2 layers. It was distilled on 2B tokens of The deduplicated Pile and 2B of the math split from Llama Nemotron Post Training Dataset with cross entropy, KL, and cosine loss to match the activations of Qwen3-14B.
